recs.name: Distance
recs.tag: It's an idol's job to bring hope to people, and not just on the stage.

lines.x: What's going on?! Who are these people...?
It's... it's Reunion! Why are they attacking us?!
H-Huh...? What is going on—
What... What are you people doing?
Stop it! This is our neighborhood!
Gah, scram if you don't want trouble!
Ughh—!
You... You can't do this...
Why not? You know what kind of a rotten life you've got in this pathetic place.
Stop it—
Who's there?
I know that voice... It's her...!
I made it... *pant*...
Please don't hurt them. They are innocent!
You've already razed a few blocks' worth of streets and shops. There are the homes of innocent civilians... How are they supposed to get by now?
Who cares?
Like I give a crap how they live. Now scram, or you're next!
I'm not going to back down. I've spent my life bringing happiness... to encourage people to stay positive and live on.
That's why... if you're going to destroy their lives... I will protect them. I am more than capable.
Besides, I've got help.
Stop bluffi—
(Whistles)
Who's there...?!
Sorry we kept ya waitin', Sora.
Croissant, Exusiai, and... Texas.
I don't think they're all that discouraged by anything you just said.
In that case, it's time that we, Penguin Logistics, allies of justice, show you what for! Boink! Kapow! We'll knock you all down, just like that!
'Penguin Logistics?' Heh, you really think you can stop us?
It's an emergency, so we've got no time to check with the boss, but he's not one to just stand aside while a bunch of bad guys muck up our turf! This is where we do business, after all!
Watch out. We don't know what these men might do. I'll stall them here and put a stop to it.
Okay, Exusiai and I will take them out. Croissant, help evacuate the residents.
On it, yeehaw!
First, let's secure the path east...
Heyah—
...Huh?
W-Why can't... I... move?
Hmph, take this—
*cough*... It's the singing girl's Arts... Stop her song. Take her out first!
*Pant*... *pant*...
Did they... stop?
Heh... Trying to ambush us? Let's kick this into Overloading Mode, then!
Now. Run.
Running away? Not so fast... Let's try... this—!
Impossible... Not even my Arts are working...?
Heheh, that's not all that Sora can do! Sora, rouse me up!
Okay... on it!
Miss Sora... Is it really you? But... Why are you here...?
Now! Get 'em—
Just who are you people...?
Get clear first!
There ain't time to think 'bout all that... Giddy up! Get movin'!
(Huh? That girl over there...)
(Ugh... I can't. I can't let anybody see me like this...!)
Texas, the L.G.D.'s gonna be here mighty soon!
Alright. Exusiai, Sora—
Yes, I got it...!
Time to split! Buh-bye!
That girl...
I think I've seen her before... No, I've definitely met her before.
Is that her...?
She was at the front of the line to hand me a letter at my first fan meeting in Lungmen.
Then, after one last letter, she stopped coming to my events...
I'm sure of it. She's my very first fan, after all.
But... what is she doing here in the slums?
And... those Originium crystals on her arm...
Did she... become an Infected?
A few days later
Penguin Logistics Office
Ahh... I'm pooped.
Huh, Sora? I didn't know you were here.
Oh, Exusiai, Croissant. Yeah, I'm done with practice for the day.
That's good. We're about to head out. You wanna come with us?
We gave the L.G.D. a hand the other day, and apparently they gave Boss a call, asking us to stop by their office to get a 'Lungmen Benevolent Organization' certificate.
After we've done a photoshoot in front of L.G.D. HQ, let's see if anybody dares pull me over~
If'n yer drivin', yeah, you'll get pulled over. With them pitchers, though, I reckon ain't nobody gonna come checkin' my business licenses no more...
If you ask me, I think your little side business deserves to be inspected.
Heh, just makin' a quick buck.
So what'cha doin', Sora? Hmm... This a letter?
Yeah, it's... a letter from a fan.
Boy, that brings me back. When ya first got here, there was always all kindsa presents pilin' up in front of Penguin Logistics. Mailboxes stuffed to burstin' with fan mail.
Haha... Why don't you two go on ahead? I'll wait for Texas.
Sounds good. Here's the key. I'm hitching a ride with Croissant~
Don't worry yer li'l wings, Exusiai. I'll get'cha there safe n' sound n' right on time!
Don't be late, Sora! We don't get to be stand-up, model citizens every day!
Yeah, I won't.
(This should be the one...)
(The handwriting... I remember it very well.)
(She was there at my fan meeting... My very first fan...)
Oh... Have you been waiting for me?
Sora?
Hm? Oh, sorry, Texas. I spaced out.
It's alright.
Did something happen...?
Oh, don't worry... It's not a big deal...
Texas... Were the people we helped in the slums the other day... all Infected?
That's what's on your mind?
Yeah...
Was there somebody you knew?
I'm not sure... but I think there was a girl... who I might've met once... probably.
If that was really her, then she'd only be there because she was Infected. She wasn't... someone who lived there.
Did you see the letters?
Letters? What letters?
They came with the notice from L.G.D. this morning. Apparently they're letters of appreciation from the residents we saved.
Those letters are the reason the government is giving us that certificate.
Isn't that what you're reading right now?
Oh, no... This is... a fan letter from before.
A fan letter? You're reading it now, of all times...?
Uh... Don't worry about it...
It really is nothing, Texas. I suddenly felt like it. That's all...
Are you coming with me to the L.G.D.? I'll drive.
Mmhm. I'll go!
Get in the car then.
Texas... If... Just if. If a Lungmenite becomes infected, what options do they have?
I can only think of two.
They either have to leave Lungmen or go to the slums.
Right... There's no other way... I know that.
Texas.
Hmm?
In the future... will I be allowed to go on deliveries alone? I don't want to be a bother... but I am a member of Penguin Logistics, and I want to help out like everybody else.
Can you protect yourself?
I... I can...!
Once you prove to me you can hold your own, I won't stop you.
Yeah, thanks.
It kind of feels like I'm always thanking you...
A week later...
Lungmen, somewhere in the slums
Hello, is anybody home? Your package is here!
Who is it...?
Hello, the items you ordered on the Penguin Logistics website are here. Could you please sign for the package~?
A package...? Leave it outside the door.
Okay!
Umm... could you please sign for the package as well?
I... I'm not sure I can step outside...
Huh? Is everything okay? Do you need any help?
No, that's not what I meant... I don't want to come outside... You... You're not infected, right? I have Oripathy... I could spread it to you...
I appreciate Penguin Logistics at least letting me place orders, but you could catch Oripathy from me. Please just go!
Mister... Mister? Please, calm down.
We've got long, stable relationships with Infected clients. Oripathy isn't something you can catch from physical contact.
Don't worry. All Penguin Logistics staff have received Oripathy prevention training. You can't hurt me.
And if you need any assistance, we can help you out anytime. We've partnered with a pharmaceutical company on several projects...
Mister, are you okay?
Are you... not afraid of me?
Of course not! Penguin Logistics aims to serve all customers with wholehearted devotion!
Never mind... Leave it at the door.
Okay...
Right, can I count on you people to deliver a letter uptown for me next time?
Of course! Penguin Logistics offers mail delivery too!
Eh... fine. I need to let somebody there know how I'm doing. If they're willing to write back.
Um, Mister...? If you would like, I can help you get in touch...
No, never mind. Just stay away from me. My brain is a mess right now.
Okay...
Let's leave it at that. I'll use you guys again next time.
It wasn't her...
I couldn't find her today either... Maybe she's already left Lungmen.
Maybe it never was her anyway...
But the handwriting in the appreciation letter to Penguin Logistics is the same as the fan letter I got.
She didn't leave an address or a name. It was just a simple thank you letter, but I know it. It was you.
...I just... want to see you once again...
Are you willing to see me? Should... I even see you?
There is something I want to tell you face to face. I want to tell you that you've got to cheer up and find hope again.
Tomorrow... I'll come again tomorrow.
Two weeks later...
Lungmen slums, during a delivery
Hello, is anybody home? Your package is here!
Hello, the items you ordered on the Penguin Logistics website are here. Could you please sign for the package~?
Is anybody home?
(Grits teeth)
Hm... this is the right delivery time...
Yeah...
Hello? Is there really nobody home?
(Trembles)
...It's her voice.
But...
(It's the right place... Are they not home?)
I'll leave it at the door and send them a delivery confirmation... Okay.
Sora subconsciously places her hand on the edge of her pocket. Slowly, she takes out the letter.
On the old, tattered envelope are the words 'To Miss Sora.'
Sora has read the letter inside and compared it with the letter of appreciation countless times. Its contents have been etched into her soul—
Not only do the words of appreciation within evoke her nostalgia, they help keep her mind at ease.
How come I can't find you? I saw you around here not too long ago... Have you really gone somewhere else?
I... want to see you again.
The person inside grips the door handle.
Yet the door does not open.
But it's no big deal... I know we'll meet again.
Okay, time for the next package... Where does this one go...?
She's gone... right?
(Bends over)
(Picks up the package)
Thank you... Miss Sora.
Looks like you got my letter.
I want to see you again too, but right now... my body... my disease...
You'll be happy once I finally find the courage to face myself again, right?
I... I'll come to your concerts again, and I will be there at your fan meetings.
Someday.

recs.name: To the Stage!
recs.tag: Sora wants one oh-so-simple thing—to sing freely on the stage.

lines.x: ...Just who are you, anyway?
Penguin Logistics.
So you're with that logistics company everyone's been buzzing about, the one that's got connections on both sides of the law.
If you don't want to end up like your buddy lying over there, then get lost.
The dai lo won't let you get away with this.
He can get in line behind everyone else coming after me. Tell your dai lo he'd better hurry up.
Hmph.
Place is cleaned up.
The goods oughta be in the trunk of that car.
What are the goods anyway? You still haven't told me.
And who's the client?
And most importantly, where is the stuff going?
Client's Monster Siren Records.
We're haulin' some stuff for a concert tonight.
Got it.
As for what the stuff is—
Texas, I been thinkin'...
Whenever you say that, nothing good comes of it.
Look, we runnin' a company now, and the most important thing for a company is its corporate culture.
Corporate culture?
Yeah, we gonna build our own corporate culture, startin' today.
And today's keyword is—mystery.
You mean, we're building this thing day-by-day?
Never mind.
By now, Texas has become somewhat used to the Emperor's unpredictability.
She shrugs, opens the trunk of the car, and freezes for a moment.
There's a girl inside, bound tightly with rope, her mouth taped shut. But that isn't what makes Texas freeze—after all, she's seen this scene plenty of times before.
No, it's because she recognizes the girl.
It's Sora, the pop idol who's become viral lately. Texas likes to listen to her songs when she drives.
As soon as Sora sees Texas, she gives a pleading look and begins to struggle.
*muffled screams*!!!
Settle down.
Agh! Look at my outfit! It's all wrinkled.
*huff* Yeah, maybe I shouldn't be worrying about that right now.
Are you here to rescue me, or kill me?
Neither.
I'm here to make a delivery.
Then you must be Texas, from Penguin Logistics, right?
You know me?
This delivery job was actually something I convinced my manager to give you.
You knew you'd be kidnapped?
Yeah. There are some people who don't want me performing. They hired a gang to kidnap me.
I happened to overhear their conversation.
Oh, right, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Sora, an idol signed to Monster Siren Records.
I know.
I have your CD in my car.
Oh?! You're a fan?!
I have lots of your CDs, actually.
Thanks for your support!
Can you move?
Yes.
Let's go.
I'll give you a lift to the concert hall.
Wait a minute. If I told you to take me somewhere else, would you?
My job is to deliver the goods, that's you, to the concert hall.
But you can tell me first.
Gimme a second.
Mic test, one two one two.
Can you feel the Arts?
No.
Looks like the kidnappers really did break my mic.
Could you take me to a music store to get it fixed first?
What's wrong?
I thought you would want me to take you somewhere safe.
I'm an idol. I have a responsibility to my fans.
Besides, tonight's concert is very important. If I mess it up, the company will be pissed.
Does it matter?
Does it not?
Over there. She should be over here. Surround the area!
Tell me where the music store is.
Will you take me there?
The boss said the word of the day is 'mystery'. We're building a corporate culture, you know.
So winging it seems pretty fitting for 'mystery' right now.
Texas, I saw the CDs in your car. You haven't bought my 'sleep aid' series, have you?
I saw it in the store, but I haven't bought it yet.
I sleep just fine.
And besides, I probably don't need sleep aids when I'm driving.
That's true.
But I still highly recommend my sleep aid series.
You can give it to your insomniac friends!
Looks like you're pretty proud of those.
I'm proud of all my music!
I guarantee the sleep aid series will have you snoozing on your pillow!
Unless, of course, you cover your ears. Then it may not be as effective.
Next time I can't sleep, I'll give it a try.
Oh, right. We should exchange contact info.
I'll just send you one for free.
Compliments of rescuing me from the gang's evil clutches.
Thanks.
I'm the one who should be thanking you.
Alright. We're here.
Give me a sec. I'll be out in real quick.
Okay.
I found her! She's over here!
Get her! Be careful! She's a tricky one!
*sigh* They never learn, do they?
Allow me.
Cover your ears, Texas!
Texas knows what's coming. She quickly covers her ears.
She sees Sora hop onto an adjacent balcony from the second floor of the music store and begins singing into her microphone.
Kill that gir.... huh? I feel... funny.
My eyes are so heavy...
What a nice song. I feel... sleepy... g'night... zzzzzz
After Sora starts singing, the gangsters fall to the floor and drift off into a deep sleep.
Texas feels relieved, but quickly realizes it's because of Sora's singing.
...Something's not right.
One time, when I was little, I got really annoyed and sang at the top of my lungs. Somehow, all the kids who heard me got angry too...
That's when I knew my singing could 'influence' people.
If I have a strong thought in my mind and don't try to suppress it, it comes out in my song, and I can't guarantee who it might affect.
Sorry, Texas.
I know you're very capable, which is why I had to lead you to believe...
That you could block my song by covering your ears.
Of course, that's not true.
Wh-Why did you?
So I could get away from all of this.
I'm so sorry.
You should apologize... to yourself.
After all, you've just sealed your own fate.
Huh?
How are you—
Your Arts are unique.
All it took was a little bit of digging to find that out.
But those idiots thought dealing with a 'little singer' would be easy. Now I can swoop in and get all the credit.
This crossbow ain't a toy, missy. If you don't wanna die, I suggest you stay put.
But there's no need to be scared. The higher-ups want you alive.
And I have to thank you too. That Texas from Penguin Logistics has been making a real name for herself lately. I don't think I could've taken her alone.
'Get away from all of this.' Ha!
You privileged kids really do have some funny ideas, that's for sure.
You don't get it.
You're right. I don't. You've got such a great life, singing and dancing for money, and getting all that attention.
And yet, you want to throw that life away, by the hands of a gangster no less.
I'd start regretting if I were you.
I'm stupid... I admit it.
From the start, I kept imagining all the ways I might fail, but I guess I underestimated you and ended up giving away my only chance of being saved.
The reason I failed is kinda funny, even to me.
But... if 'a good life' means singing the songs you're told, saying the words you're given, following the set schedule, and smiling on command every single day...
I rather throw it away.
And the only thing I regret now is not having prepared better.
But for trying to escape this life? I have no regrets.
You're bold, I'll give you that.
Don't worry. You'll get what you wish for.
That's not up to you.
What?!
Guh—
Texas, you—
This isn't the best place for a chat.
Let's go.
This should be far enough.
Texas...
Your lullaby really is something.
I almost didn't wake up.
You're the first person who's ever woken up that quickly.
I used to always be alert, paying attention to everything around me. I guess it's become a habit now.
Sorry, Texas.
You already apologized.
Could you be a little angrier? Otherwise, I feel kinda bad...
You have no regrets, and so, I have no reason to be angry.
Ah, haha, you heard me say that.
And I don't think there's anything wrong with it.
Huh?
Really?
You don't like your current life and want to get away from it. There's really nothing wrong with that.
But like you said, next time you should prepare better.
*sigh* If someone had told me what you just did, maybe I would have changed my mind.
Really? But I was encouraging you to escape.
You don't get it.
Sometimes, just having someone who understands can stop you from doing something reckless.
If I had met you earlier, I could've opened up to you about all the things that were bothering me.
And maybe you would've comforted me, talked smack with me about the people who were bad to me.
I'm not one for talking smack, but I could just smack them for you.
Well then I would have stopped you. I'm against violence!
We might have differing philosophies, but at least now I have someone to talk to.
Actually, this is exactly what I've been looking for.
If I had a friend like you in the beginning, I would never have done this.
It's getting late.
Yeah...
But before I leave, could you put on a show with me?
I don't know how.
I'll do the singing. You just need to ask the questions.
And you'll know which questions to ask.
Sora walks under a streetlight and holds up her microphone. She extends her hand to Texas and invites her to come forward.
There once was a girl who lived in a high-rise in Lungmen.
Left alone in her big, empty home, she learned how to sing from the idols on TV.
From morning to night, from dusk to dawn...
Music was her only friend.
Texas knows her songs from listening to them while she drives. She always thought they were nice.
However, at this moment, as Texas listens to Sora's singing, she hears not just the usual beauty in her voice, but also the vitality.
That forceful, explosive vitality.
She feels compelled to start speaking.
What about her parents?
Her father is a businessman. Her mother is a C-list celebrity.
Their marriage was a spur-of-the-moment decision, and their careers are both so demanding.
How could they have room to love that which was born, unexpectedly, from impulse?
Did she start singing because she was lonely?
At first, she sang to express her loneliness.
Later, she learned to express more emotions through song.
Singing isn't her crutch, it's her companion.
How did she become an idol?
She didn't want to sing to an empty room.
She wanted people to hear her songs...
So she left her home and went to the garden downstairs.
The neighbor's kids were playing. She stood in between them and started singing.
Her singing attracted other children, as well as their parents.
That's how she was discovered.
Did she want to be a pop idol?
Everyone was so happy.
Her parents no longer needed to worry about their daughter's future. They had one less burden.
And Monster Siren Records had a new star.
The girl was also very happy, at the time.
She loved singing to her bones.
She wanted more people to hear her songs.
But things didn't always go her way.
Yes! Yes!
Thank you, everyone, for coming to my show!
I'll be bringing you all even more amazing performances in the future. Please continue to support me!
I'm very happy to meet you all. I hope you can come to my next show!
This is the script she has to repeat every time.
She has more she wants to say.
She has more songs she wants to sing.
Why didn't she tell that to the person around her?
She already told them, but it didn't do any good.
They all told her, 'That's the price you pay for being an idol.'
She doesn't hate them. They love her and care for her.
But she also does hate them, because they've never really cared about her feelings.
They only treat her well because—
She is following the path they chose for her.
So she decided to run away.
When she told her manager, her manager said it was common in the industry.
That's when she decided...
She might as well disappear.
But she loves the stage.
It lets more people hear her songs.
She loves the attention.
She just wants to be heard.
What are her true hopes and dreams?
She's only ever had one true dream—
To be able to sing...
as a free soul...
Without a care in the world!
The riverwalk is empty.
Her only audience is the bright moon, the cool breeze, and Texas.
But Sora has a huge smile on her face.
Thank you, Texas
For helping me fulfill my wish.
Take me to the concert, please.
No, I'm gonna take you back to the Penguin Logistics office.
This...
Yes. The Penguin Logistics office.
I have other orders to deliver.
You can stay here for as long as you like.
Is this gonna be a problem for you with Monster Siren Records?
Yeah, but it's not a big deal.
Why... did you help me?
Last year, I decided to leave Columbia, but I didn't know where to go.
Back then, someone took me to Lungmen, to this very room.
They told me I could stay here for as long as I liked.
And then you just stayed?
And then, we founded Penguin Logistics.
You're saying you were like me? You wanted to run away from your past?
Run away from it? No.
I was just tired of it.
Same as you're tired of being held back by all those rules.
But you're so strong.
My sword can't solve everything.
After hearing you say all that, I know we should've found each other a long time ago.
You could have encouraged me...
And I could have encouraged you.
It's not too late.
Do you mean to say that we're friends now?
I don't have many friends, so I'm not really sure.
Now that you mention it, I don't have many people around me that I can call friends either.
But, we've already shared a bit of our past with each other. Usually, only friends talk about that stuff, right?
True...
Then that settles it. We are friends!
You can call me Sora.
Okay, Sora.
Texas, where you at?!
(Whisper) I'll make myself scarce.
(Whisper) It's fine.
I'm at the office.
Don't you got deliveries to make?
Something came up, so no.
(Whisper) Should you really be that blunt?!
Aight. Word of the day is 'mystery' n' all.
That's a mysterious answer, so we good!
Oh, right, almost forgot the important thing.
(Whisper) I'm not the 'important thing'?!
What'choo doin' right now?
About to deliver an order.
Scratch that. Our keyboard player just had a bad breakup n' vanished. You're on the keyboard!
Usual place?
You know it.
Okay.
Gotta go.
You rest here.
If you want to leave, that's fine too. Just make sure to pull the door down from the outside. Thanks.
Wait.
Hm?
Can I go with you?
Are you afraid of the dark? I'll turn on a light for you.
No.
I'm the one who caused all this trouble. I should go tell Emperor, personally.
That works.
Boss, I'm here.
Yeah, just in time.
Hm?
Mr. Emperor, sir....
Texas, when you said 'something came up', was you talkin' about this shawty?
Yes.
She didn't want to go, so I didn't take her.
Oh, aight.
That's it? Just 'aight'?
What? Decided you wanna go now?
No.
Then you don't go. I'll handle Monster Siren Records.
Thank you... Mr. Emperor.
Cool. Texas, go get ready. I'mma 'bout to take the stage.
Okay.
Texas, you can play an instrument?
Yeah. Boss forced me to learn a few.
He's always saying a good Messenger has to play a musical instrument, so I did.
Personally, I like the cello.
Haha! I'd love to see you play the cello.
Next time maybe.
Hey, can I ask you how you left? Columbia, I mean.
Did you do what I did and just leave everything behind, all of a sudden?
No.
I started a fire, ki... fought some people, and told everyone to stay away from me.
Will they listen?
They will. They know who I am, so they won't come looking for me.
Although, it seems one of them still hasn't given up yet.
Well, did you do it?
Do what?
Did you really escape your past?
Since I left, I've only been certain about one thing—
One day, my past will catch up to me.
Why?
Because I grew up in that world.
The ties I have with it can't be severed by any sword.
It's like rainwater flowing into the drain, then the river. But eventually, it evaporates and becomes rain again.
You mean running away is pointless?
No. It got me to Lungmen, to your songs. It made us friends.
And I've come to realize that delivering packages isn't nearly as easy as I thought.
So when your past does catch up to you, what will you do then?
I'll cross that bridge when I come to it.
That's all?
Yeah. That's all.
Pfft!
What's wrong?
Nothing. It's just that... I feel like so many of my problems suddenly melted away.
You ready, Texas?
Yeah.
Aight...
Emperor, I took a look at the set list. Can I join you for the next one, please?
Oh? You wanna try one of my legendary tracks for yourself?
You may not know, but I've been practicing my rapping. I've perfected my flow.
It's just that the label never gives me a chance to rap.
Naw, I know.
Huh?
Our recording studios are pretty damned close, c'mon.
So... what do you think of my rapping?
I think I can take this song, and this stage, and hand 'em right off to you.
Thanks!
I only got one condition.
Bring the house down, right?
Leave it to me!
Hey! Shouldn't Emperor be on vocals? What's that girl doing onstage?
She looks familiar. Wait, it's Sora, from Monster Siren Records!
What's she doing here? Can she even rap?
Everyone is so surprised.
I'm even more surprised you can do one of boss's songs.
I'm a professional, I'll have you know.
And also...
I've changed my mind, Texas.
After I finish this one, can you take me to the concert hall?
I should still be able to make it.
Are you sure?
Yeah, I'm sure.
Hello everyone. Today I will be performing an Emperor classic.
Some of you may know me, and some of you may not. It's fine either way.
Just remember to get on your feet and make some noise!
Because tonight, we're tearing the roof down!
Alright. This is far enough.
From here on, I'll go it alone.
You don't need my help?
This is my business, and I'll handle it.
Thank you, Texas.
You already thanked me.
One thank you is not enough.
You saved my life; you listened to me. Plus, you told me—
That even if I'm going to leave, I should tell everyone what kind of person I am.
Now that I think about it, if I just up and left, everyone would just think of me as 'that teen idol.' That's not the legacy I want for myself.
I just never had the courage to face up to it before.
Now I do.
